svg.title: Size separation through a porous gel
svg.desc: Original schematic showing four large yellow, six medium green and eight small pink macromolecules in each state. The initial mixture begins near the top. After downward migration through the porous gel, large molecules remain nearest the origin, medium molecules travel farther, and small molecules travel farthest. Horizontal arrow joins before and after states; the vertical arrow shows migration. Spheres, pore geometry, counts and distances are illustrative, not measured DNA geometry. Source teaching context: Genetics LECT02F page 9, image_006.jpg; Biochemistry: A Short Course, Second Edition, W. H. Freeman and Company, 2013. Original artwork constructed independently for this course.
